dedupe_keys.name: apur open data building footprints heights heating needs and facility footprints for paris and greater paris

description: The Paris urban planning agency Apur publishes 139 datasets on its ArcGIS Hub portal, most under the Open Database Licence. For buildings, the Emprise bâtie Paris layer gives footprints of buildings or building parts carrying dating and height information and can be joined to cadastral parcels; an extension covers the rest of the Métropole du Grand Paris with more than one million buildings and heights derived from the elevation model. A combined layer adds typological and morphological attributes and modelled residential heating needs or heat losses for Paris and the metropolis. Other layers cover building heights and vegetation heights for several years, demolitions, building use, facility footprints for schools, health, green spaces, culture, worship and transport, and planning rules on heights and footprints. Coverage: Paris, with several layers for the Greater Paris metropolis. Access: downloads as Shapefile, GeoJSON, CSV or KML and ArcGIS services, with a OneDrive fallback for the largest files. Licence: ODbL for most datasets; free. Caveats: metropolitan layers are less complete and less finely split than Paris, and footprints derive from DGFiP cadastral vectors reworked by Apur, not the official cadastre. Simulation uses are building geometry, age and heating inputs for urban heat, energy and flood models. Related records: the IGN BD TOPO and the BDNB.
